prompt: The contains check always returns false. Why?
choices: contains() only works on single characters
String comparison in Java is case-sensitive — 'World' and 'world' do not match
needle must be a char, not a String
explanation: contains() (and all String searches) are case-sensitive. 'World' != 'world'. Fix: haystack.toLowerCase().contains(needle.toLowerCase()) for a case-insensitive check.
